effects.printed_clause: If you control no monsters, or control a Dragon Xyz, Special Summon this card from hand.
effects.lua_implementation: An unclassified hand SPSUMMON_PROC checks open zone and either empty own MZONE or face-up Dragon Xyz.

official_references.matched_structure: Kashtira Fenrir supplies official condition-based hand Special Summon procedure.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon ELECTRIC monsters for the rest of turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The procedure operation registers player-target CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON for ELECTRIC through End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Kashtira hand procedures demonstrate post-procedure player restrictions with End Phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz to activate its effect: target a Stellaer Xyz in GY.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_MOVE now catches the material moving from overlay to either the GY or banishment; the condition verifies REASON_COST and that the activating handler is a Stellaer Xyz Monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Gagaga Ganbara Knight is an official trigger for being detached from an Xyz Monster to activate its effect.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: EVENT_TO_GRAVE missed a detached material redirected to banishment. Official Gagaga Ganbara Knight uses EVENT_MOVE for the same destination-independent wording.

effects.printed_clause: Special Summon that Xyz, but negate its effects.
effects.lua_implementation: The target is revived from GY and receives DISABLE/DISABLE_EFFECT with standard reset.

official_references.matched_structure: Monster Reborn supplies revive handling; official negated-revival scripts install DISABLE effects.

effects.printed_clause: The detached effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.
